name: Piping
description: Corded piping run along one edge of each panel, switching from hem to head with every row.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 76%; width: 100%; height: 24%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@y % 2 == 1) { :after { top: 0; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
